title: Sequence Variables: A Constraint Programming Computational Domain for Routing and Sequencing
abstract: arXiv:2510.09373v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Constraint Programming (CP) offers an intuitive, declarative framework for modeling Vehicle Routing Problems (VRP). While classical successor-based CP models can be adapted to handle optional visits or insertion-based heuristics, sequence variables provide a significantly more natural and elegant formulation for these requirements. Building upon our prior work that introduced the initial concept, the main contribution of this article is the complete semantic and operational formalization of sequence variables as a computational domain. Specifically, we formally define the sequence domain and its update operations, and detail the implementation and data structures required to integrate sequence variables into trail-based CP solvers. translated_abstract: 约束编程（CP）为车辆路径问题（VRP）的建模提供了一个直观的、声明式的框架。虽然经典的基于后继的CP模型经过调整可以处理可选访问节点或基于插入的启发式方法，但序列变量为这些需求提供了更加自然和优雅的建模方式。在我们先前引入该初始概念的工作基础上，本文的主要贡献是将序列变量作为一种计算域进行完整的语义和操作层面的形式化。具体而言，我们正式定义了序列域及其更新操作，并详细介绍了将序列变量集成到基于轨迹（trail-based）的CP求解器所需的实现方法和数据结构。此外，我们为该域上的相关约束引入了一致性级别，并提供了专门为路径问题定制的全局约束。最后，我们证明了序列变量……
tldr: 本文将序列变量完整形式化为约束编程中用于路径规划与排序问题的一种计算域，正式定义了序列域及其更新操作，给出了集成到基于轨迹的CP求解器的实现与数据结构，并引入一致性级别和面向路径问题的专用全局约束。
en_tdlr: This paper fully formalizes sequence variables as a computational domain in Constraint Programming for routing and sequencing problems, defining the sequence domain and its update operations, detailing the implementation and data structures for integrating them into trail-based CP solvers, and introducing consistency levels along with specialized global constraints for routing problems.
